water.name: Distilled water 1 gal
water.pack: White-capped plastic jug, blue Pure Life label
water.does: Fills the bladder and the muscle; distilled so nothing grows or corrodes.
water.goes: Inside the bladder chambers and the McKibben tube, via syringe.

braid.name: PET braided sleeving 1/4 + 1/2 in
braid.size: 1/4 in sleeve (expands about 50%), 25 ft roll; plus a 1/2 in roll
braid.pack: Two black coils in a clear bag
braid.does: Turns the tube's swelling into a pull: the woven sleeve shortens as the tube inside fattens.
braid.goes: Over the 15 cm silicone tube of the McKibben muscle.

cuni.name: Copper-nickel fabric + tape (electrodes + shield)
cuni.size: 1 yard sheet, 44 x 36 in (112 x 91 cm), thin as cloth; plus a roll of conductive tape
cuni.pack: Silver-grey metallic fabric folded in a red-and-white FARADAY FABRIC pack, tape roll inside
cuni.does: Conductive fabric: the touch strips that feel a hand coming, plus the shield sheet, wired to GND.
cuni.goes: Strips under the top fabric; the ground sheet under the felt.

tees.name: 1/8 in barb tees
tees.size: Small T, about the size of a fingernail; fits 1/8 in tube
tees.pack: 10 white plastic T's, loose in a small bag
tees.does: Splits one 1/8 in line into two.
tees.goes: On the fill/purge line next to the stopcock, and where a line must branch.

syringe.name: 60 mL luer-lock syringes
syringe.size: 60 mL: barrel about 3 cm wide, 13 cm long (about a marker pen)
syringe.pack: 10 syringes, each sealed in its own paper-and-plastic sterile pouch
syringe.does: Pushes and pulls water by hand; later the reservoirs for the pumps.
syringe.goes: On a luer-barb or stopcock at the end of a line.

ds18.name: DS18B20 probes x4
ds18.size: Steel probe 6 mm x 50 mm (a pencil stub) on a 1 m black cable, 3 bare wires
ds18.pack: 4 coiled black cables with shiny steel tips, small bag
ds18.does: Waterproof temperature probe; four of them on one wire.
ds18.goes: Taped beside the heater film and on the bladder floor; data to GPIO25.

qwiic.name: Qwiic cable kit
qwiic.size: Cables 10, 20, 30 and 50 cm with tiny 4-pin black plugs (smaller than a grain of rice wide)
qwiic.pack: 12 thin 4-colour cables in a flat bag
qwiic.does: Plug-in cable for the pressure sensor: power + I2C in one connector.
qwiic.goes: Between the MicroPressure board and the ESP32 (SDA GPIO21 / SCL GPIO22).

felt.name: Felt sheets 1.5 mm (spacer)
felt.pack: 6 white sheets, stacked flat in a sleeve
felt.does: Soft spacer: gives the touch strips distance and the pad its squish.
felt.goes: Between the strips and the ground, and under the pads.

ksd.name: KSD301 40 C cutoff
ksd.size: Round metal-capped disc about 20 mm wide (a US nickel) with two 6.3 mm flat tabs
ksd.pack: 5 discs in a small bag, '40' stamped on the cap
ksd.does: Thermal cutoff: a switch that opens near 40 C, a hardware backstop to the firmware.
ksd.goes: In series with each heater film, sitting on top of it.

drv.name: DRV8833 motor driver
drv.size: Tiny board 18.5 x 16 mm (a fingernail), pins already soldered
drv.pack: 5 black boards in an anti-static bag
drv.does: Motor driver: lets the ESP32 run each pump forward and back.
drv.goes: On the 5 V rail, between the ESP32 and the two pumps.

tpu.name: TPU fabric 1 yd
tpu.size: 1 yard (0.9 m) by 54 in (1.37 m) wide, 0.3 mm thick, black
tpu.pack: Folded black waterproof fabric, smooth shiny side = TPU
tpu.does: Heat-weldable fabric: the walls of the water bladder and the nozzle flanges.
tpu.goes: Two panels welded into the two-chamber bladder; 20 mm discs around the luer-barbs.

plugs.name: Luer plugs
plugs.size: Red cap about 1.5 cm long (a pea)
plugs.pack: 20 red caps, each in its own sterile B.BRAUN Red Cap blister pack
plugs.goes: On the dead end of the muscle and on the fill ports.

unions.name: 1/8 in barb unions
unions.size: Straight double barb about 2 cm long, for 1/8 in tube
unions.pack: 5 white/clear plastic tubes with ridges both ends, small bag
unions.goes: Wherever a tube meets a tube, e.g. pouch neck to the sensor line.

ptfe.name: PTFE sheets
ptfe.size: Sheets 12 x 16 in, 0.1 mm thick, tan/brown
ptfe.pack: 3 tan sheets rolled or flat, with a white marker pen
ptfe.does: Non-stick sheet: the iron welds TPU through it without sticking.
ptfe.goes: Above and below the TPU every time you iron a seam or a flange.

stopcock.name: 3-way luer stopcocks
stopcock.size: 3-way valve about 6 cm (2.5 in) long, blue handle
stopcock.pack: 6 valves, each in its own clear sterile blister
stopcock.does: 3-way valve: fill and purge a chamber without letting air back in.
stopcock.goes: On each chamber's fill line, with a syringe on one port.

mosfet.name: NOYITO LR7843 MOSFET module
mosfet.size: Board 23 x 16 mm with a blue and a green screw terminal
mosfet.pack: 2 black boards + loose terminals and pins
mosfet.does: Electronic switch: the ESP32 turns the heater film on and off through it.
mosfet.goes: Between the 5 V rail and the heater film.

mpr.name: MPR121 capacitive breakout (backup)
mpr.size: Board about 16 x 8 mm, header pins loose
mpr.pack: 1 black board with a strip of pins
mpr.does: Backup capacitive-touch board, only if the ESP32's own touch pins misbehave.

tube2.name: 2 mm ID silicone tube (sensor port)
tube2.size: 2 mm inside / 4 mm outside, clear, 1 m
tube2.pack: Clear thin tube coiled in a bag
tube2.does: Thin tube that carries air from the bladder's pocket to the pressure sensor.
tube2.goes: From the pouch / bladder port up to the MicroPressure.

caps.name: Electrolytic capacitor kit
caps.size: Cans 5-13 mm across; the 1000 uF is the biggest, about 10 x 20 mm
caps.pack: Clear plastic organiser with a yellow label, 24 labelled compartments
caps.does: Bulk capacitor: steadies the 5 V rail when the pumps kick on.

luerbarb.name: Female luer to 1/8 in barb
luerbarb.size: About 2 cm long, clear; barb end fits 1/8 in (2.8-3.6 mm ID) tube
luerbarb.pack: 10 clear fittings loose in a small bag
luerbarb.does: The bladder NOZZLE (since 10/14): luer end for syringes, barb end for 1/8 in tube; a welded TPU flange seals it into the bladder.
luerbarb.goes: Welded into the pouch and the bladder ports; also at both ends of the muscle.

zip.name: Zip ties
zip.size: 4 in (10 cm) long, 2.5 mm wide, black
zip.pack: Black ties in a resealable bag with a black-and-white TANTTI label
zip.does: Clamps tube onto a barb so it cannot slip off under pressure.

pumps.name: 6 V peristaltic pumps x2
pumps.size: Motor + black pump head about 28 x 38 mm (1.1 x 1.5 in), two short clear hoses
pumps.pack: 2 pumps, black heads with a barcode label on the motor
pumps.does: Peristaltic pumps: move water in and out of the chambers to make the breath.
pumps.goes: Between the syringe-barrel reservoirs and chambers A and B.

usbc.name: USB-C to screw terminal
usbc.size: USB-C socket with a green 2-screw terminal, about 3 cm long
usbc.does: Turns the USB-C supply into two screw terminals for the rail.
usbc.goes: At the start of the 5 V rail.

psens.name: SparkFun Qwiic MicroPressure (25 psi)
psens.size: Red SparkFun board 1 x 1 in (26 x 27 mm), small round metal sensor in the middle
psens.pack: 1 red board in an anti-static bag
psens.does: Pressure sensor: reads presses, squeezes and breath through the air pocket.
psens.goes: On the end of the 2 mm air tube; Qwiic to the ESP32.

thread.name: Stainless conductive thread
thread.size: 0.2 mm thread, 23 m on a bobbin about 4 cm wide
thread.pack: Small metal or plastic bobbin of grey shiny thread
thread.does: Sewable wire: stitches the strips down and carries their signal.
thread.goes: Leads from each strip and pad to the edge of the stack.

heater.name: 5 V 8 W heater film x2
heater.size: Round orange pad 50 mm across (a big cookie) with a 30 cm two-wire lead
heater.pack: 2 orange polyimide discs with black leads
heater.does: Thin heating pad: the warmth of the skin, 8 W at 5 V.
heater.goes: Outside the bladder floor, one KSD301 on each.

fuse.name: Inline fuse holders + 3 A fuses
fuse.size: Inline holder on 30 cm red 18 AWG leads; mini blade fuses about 11 mm
fuse.pack: 6 black holders with red leads, 6 fuses, heat-shrink connectors
fuse.does: 3 A fuse: blows before a short can heat a wire.
fuse.goes: Inline on the + side of the 5 V rail.

tube.name: Silicone tubing 1/8 in ID, 5 ft
tube.size: 1/8 in inside (3.2 mm) / 1/4 in outside (6.4 mm), 5 ft (1.5 m), white-clear
tube.does: Main 1/8 in silicone line for water.
tube.goes: Pump and syringe lines; the McKibben muscle core.

supply.name: 5 V 3 A USB-C supply
supply.size: Wall plug with a 1.5 m (5 ft) cord, USB-C end
supply.does: The only power source: 5 V 3 A, no mains near the skin.
supply.goes: Plugs into the USB-C screw terminal.

velostat.name: Velostat XL sheets
velostat.size: Each sheet 102 x 95 mm (a large sticky note), black plastic
velostat.pack: 5 black sheets in a small Chibitronics bag
velostat.does: Pressure-sensitive sheet: its resistance drops where it is pressed.
velostat.goes: Between the Cu-Ni ground and the 4 pads in the sensing stack.

esp32.name: ESP32-WROOM (ESP32-DevKitC)
esp32.size: Dev board about 55 x 28 mm (a stick of gum), micro-USB on the end
esp32.pack: Hers already; black board with two rows of pins, silver WROOM-32 can on top
esp32.does: The brain: reads every sensor, drives the pumps and heaters, logs to the laptop.
esp32.goes: Beside the pad; everything wires back to it.
esp32.photoFrom: Wikimedia Commons: ESP32 Espressif ESP-WROOM-32 Dev Board.jpg (CC0; stand-in, not her own)

iron.name: Household iron
iron.does: Heat source for every TPU weld.
iron.goes: On the PTFE sandwich, at the seal setting found on Day 2.
iron.photoFrom: Wikimedia Commons: Electric steam iron.jpg (stand-in, not her own)

resist.name: 4.7 kOhm resistors
resist.size: Tiny beige cylinder 6 mm long with wire legs; 4.7 kOhm = yellow-violet-red bands
resist.does: 4.7 kOhm: the pull-up the temperature bus needs, and the series resistor on each pad.
resist.goes: GPIO25 to 3.3 V; one in each pad line.
resist.photoFrom: Wikimedia Commons: Electronic Axial Lead Resistors 47kOhm.jpg (stand-in, not her own)

meter.name: Multimeter
meter.size: Handheld meter with red and black probes
meter.does: Measures volts and continuity: proves the rail, the cutoff and the MOSFET.
meter.goes: Probes on whatever you are checking.
meter.photoFrom: Wikimedia Commons: Digital Multimeter Aka.jpg (stand-in, not her own)

organic.name: Organic fabric (top skin)
organic.size: Her own natural-fibre fabric; cut 17 x 17 cm
organic.does: The top skin, the only part a hand touches.
organic.goes: Top of the sensing stack, 17 x 17 cm.
organic.photoFrom: Wikimedia Commons: Moslin 8.jpg (stand-in, not her own)
